bio: I'm a Software Engineering student at Air University, Multan, and I love building scalable, high-performance systems. My focus is backend architecture, database design, and full-stack development: turning complex problems into clean, efficient solutions.

I build structured, secure applications with Python, Node.js, SQL and .NET. From banking management systems to full-stack web platforms, I engineer software that is reliable, optimized, and built for growth.

items.title: Design before code
items.text: Requirements, data model and architecture get written down and reviewed before implementation starts.

items.title: Readable over clever
items.text: Code is read far more often than it's written, so I optimise for the next person who opens the file.

items.title: Secure by default
items.text: Validation, least privilege and safe data handling are part of the first version, not a later patch.

items.title: Measure, then optimise
items.text: Performance work starts from a measurement, so effort goes where it actually matters.

items.title: Ship in small steps
items.text: Small, reviewable changes keep risk low and make progress visible every week.

items.title: Document for handover
items.text: Clear SDD documentation means the system outlives the sprint that built it.
